citations.A1: Root cause: indefinite cache with single `_cache is None` check; reload only happens on first call, never when file changes.
citations.A2: Wrong fix—periodic reload on timer: Arbitrary intervals; doesn't detect actual changes, wastes I/O on unchanged files.
citations.A3: Wrong fix—caller-controlled reload parameter: Callers don't know when the file changed; burden is shifted, not solved.
